subject: onchain.records

recordTypes.summary: One public onchain account identity and its governed organizational purpose without credential or signing material.

fields.summary: The exact public account address as observed.
The governed network on which the account identity exists.
The governed wallet, safe, contract, or other public-account classification.
The exact internal label used to identify the public account.
The factual organizational function assigned to the public account.
Exact process definitions permitted to establish account verification.
Exact completed process-run evidence identities supporting the current verification state.
Whether current linked evidence satisfies the governed verification rule.

content.summary: Address records contain public identity and governance facts only.

limitations: The governed context.onchain vocabulary artifact owns the exact current address term and definition.
Private keys, seed phrases, signing material, credentials, and transaction payloads are structurally outside this portable record model.
A verified value is only a domain field; it grants no signing, dispatch, transaction, provider-write, or execution authority.
